id_policy: New numeric table primary keys; legacy VID/EID/rank are not output as structural keys. Legacy identities are used only in private staging. Business properties are preserved unchanged.
warnings: This restores the records actually present in the archive; six endpoint-only large edge exports may omit parallel-rank edges from the original database.
Some edge endpoints have no exported node properties. Their new identifiers are preserved in kg_node_index and kg_missing_node; no names or business attributes are fabricated.
organization_base is a shared tag whose rows duplicate business nodes exactly; it is retained in kg_node_index.labels rather than imported as separate entities.
v_input_* views include explicitly flagged empty endpoint placeholders where a schema can be inferred from the legacy prefix. An inferred schema is not an exported tag.
Column types are inferred from observed graph values; this is a relational projection of the export, not a reconstruction of the original upstream MySQL DDL.
Empty node/edge schema types without JSONL files are not recreated because their property definitions are not present in this data archive.
